meta.note: Hover для cdm8e: правьте mnemonics ниже. Другие диалекты: cdm8_mnemonics.json, cdm16_mnemonics.json, cdm16e_mnemonics.json (см. hover_help.py).

add.description: Add rn and rm into rm; C,V,Z,N updated.

addc.description: Add rn, rm, and carry C into rm (multi-byte arithmetic). C,V,Z,N updated.

addsp.description: Add const to SP (stack pointer). Flags unchanged.

and.description: Bitwise AND rn with rm into rm. Z,N reflect result; C,V cleared.

asect.description: Start an absolute section: following code is placed at the given base address in address space.

banything.description: Unconditional relative branch (always). Alias nop/branches listed share opcode space. Mnemonic aliases: br, banything, btrue.

bcc.description: Branch if unsigned lower / carry clear (C clear). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: blo, bcc.

bcs.description: Branch if unsigned higher or same / carry set (C set). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: bhs, bcs.

beq.description: Branch if equal / zero (Z set). Relative offset; assembler computes displacement. Mnemonic aliases: beq, bz.

bfalse.description: Forms paired with unconditional branch; false branch behaves as no-op on CdM-8e. Mnemonic aliases: nop, bnanything, bntrue, bfalse.

bge.description: Branch if signed greater or equal ((N∧V)∨(¬N∧¬V)). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: bge.

bgt.description: Branch if signed greater ((¬Z∧N∧V)∨(¬Z∧¬N∧¬V)). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: bgt.

bhi.description: Branch if unsigned higher (C∧¬Z). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: bhi.

bhs.description: Branch if unsigned higher or same / carry set (C set). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: bhs, bcs.

ble.description: Branch if signed less or equal ((Z∨N∧¬V)∨(¬N∧V)). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: ble.

blo.description: Branch if unsigned lower / carry clear (C clear). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: blo, bcc.

bls.description: Branch if unsigned lower or same (¬C ∨ Z). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: bls.

blt.description: Branch if signed less than (N⊕V). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: blt.

bmi.description: Branch if negative / minus (N set). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: bmi.

bnanything.description: Forms paired with unconditional branch; false branch behaves as no-op on CdM-8e. Mnemonic aliases: nop, bnanything, bntrue, bfalse.

bncc.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bncs.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bne.description: Branch if not equal / not zero (Z clear). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: bne, bnz, bneq.

bneq.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bnfalse.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bnge.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bngt.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bnhi.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bnhs.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bnle.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bnlo.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bnls.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bnlt.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bnmi.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bnne.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bnnz.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bnpl.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bntrue.description: Forms paired with unconditional branch; false branch behaves as no-op on CdM-8e. Mnemonic aliases: nop, bnanything, bntrue, bfalse.

bnvc.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bnvs.description: Alias for opposite-condition branch encoding used by assembler control-flow lowering.

bnz.description: Branch if not equal / not zero (Z clear). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: bne, bnz, bneq.

bpl.description: Branch if plus / non-negative (N clear). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: bpl.

br.description: Unconditional relative branch (always). Alias nop/branches listed share opcode space. Mnemonic aliases: br, banything, btrue.

btrue.description: Unconditional relative branch (always). Alias nop/branches listed share opcode space. Mnemonic aliases: br, banything, btrue.

bvc.description: Branch if overflow clear (V clear). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: bvc.

bvs.description: Branch if overflow set (V set). Relative offset. Mnemonic aliases: bvs.

bz.description: Branch if equal / zero (Z set). Relative offset; assembler computes displacement. Mnemonic aliases: beq, bz.

cmp.description: Compare rn with rm by computing (rn − rm); registers unchanged; C,V,Z,N updated.

continue.description: Jump to next iteration of the innermost while/until loop.

crc.description: Exchange PC with value at top of stack (coroutine / continuation helper).

dc.description: Define constant(s): emit bytes from expressions or string literals.

dec.description: Decrement rn as binary number (wraps). C,V,Z,N updated.

define.description: Standard macro: define label at absolute section base (*define/2 in library).

di.description: Standard macro: disable interrupts (clears PS via interrupt-vector trick).

ds.description: Reserve size bytes initialized to zero; size must be a numeric constant.

ei.description: Standard macro: enable interrupts (sets I bit in PS via interrupt-vector trick).

else.description: Optional alternative branch in an if-block.

end.description: Marks the end of the source file (translation unit). Required for a complete program the parser accepts.

ext.description: Mark label(s) as external (shared across files) in standalone label lines.

goto.description: Structured long branch: goto condition, target — assembler emits short branch or branch+jmp.

halt.description: Stop the clock; PC not updated — restarting re-executes halt.

high.description: Byte specifier: high byte of a 16-bit address expression (inside high(expr)).

if.description: Start a conditional block; paired with fi (and optional else).
if.example:
if
    cmp r0, r1
is eq
    …
fi

inc.description: Increment rn as binary number (wraps). C,V,Z,N updated.

ioi.description: Hardware/software interrupt entry: push PC and PS, load PC/PS from vector.

is.description: Separates condition code from the branch mnemonic in if/while condition lines.

jmp.description: Unconditional absolute jump: const → PC (16-bit). Flags unchanged.

jsr.description: Jump subroutine: push return PC (little-endian), then const → PC. Flags unchanged.

ld.description: Load a byte into rm from the data memory cell addressed by rn (*rn → rm). Flags unchanged.

ldc.description: Load a byte into rm from the code memory cell addressed by rn (*rn → rm). Flags unchanged.

ldi.description: Load the immediate single-byte data item const into rn. Flags unchanged.

ldsa.description: Load (SP + const) into rn. Often used with tplates for locals. Flags unchanged.

ldv.description: Standard macro: load byte from absolute address const into rn.

low.description: Byte specifier: low byte of a 16-bit address expression (inside low(expr)).

macro.description: Begin a macro definition: macro name/arity … mend.

move.description: Copy rm into rn; C,V cleared; Z,N reflect result.

neg.description: Replace rn with its 8-bit two's complement. C,V,Z,N updated.

nop.description: Forms paired with unconditional branch; false branch behaves as no-op on CdM-8e. Mnemonic aliases: nop, bnanything, bntrue, bfalse.

not.description: Flip all bits in rn. Z,N reflect result; C,V cleared.

or.description: Bitwise OR rn with rm into rm. Z,N reflect result; C,V cleared.

osix.description: Extended opcode / OS trap style instruction (opcode 0xDB); operand is a constant expression.

pop.description: Pop a byte off the stack into rn: load from *SP, then increment SP. Flags unchanged.

popall.description: Pop r0..r3 from stack and increment SP by 4. Flags unchanged.

push.description: Push the byte in rn onto the stack: decrement SP, then store rn at *SP. Flags unchanged.

pushall.description: Push r3,r2,r1,r0 onto stack and decrement SP by 4. Flags unchanged.

rannum.description: Standard macro: pseudo random helper (see standard.mlb).

restore.description: Macro/pseudo-op: pop register saved by save (optional explicit register).

rol.description: Rotate left one bit; b7→b0 and into C; V cleared.

rsect.description: Start a relocatable section named for the linker (named chunk of code/data).

rti.description: Return from interrupt: restore PC and PS from stack.

rts.description: Return from subroutine: pop PC from stack; increment SP.

save.description: Macro/pseudo-op: push register on internal stack for paired restore blocks.

setsp.description: Set SP to const. Flags unchanged.

shl.description: Standard macro: shift left one bit via addc rn,rn.

shla.description: Arithmetic shift left (multiply by 2); bit 7→C; V if sign changes.

shr.description: Logical shift right; old C into bit 7; bit 0→C.

shra.description: Arithmetic shift right (divide by 2 in two's complement); bit 0→C. Z,N,C updated; V=0.

st.description: Store the byte in rm to the data memory cell addressed by rn (rm → *rn). Flags unchanged.

stays.description: Keyword introducing the loop condition branch in while.

stv.description: Standard macro: store rn to absolute address const.

sub.description: Subtract rm from rn into rm (rn − rm → rm). C,V,Z,N updated.

then.description: Optional keyword after conditions in an if-block.

tplate.description: Declare a template section (reusable pattern with fields referenced as name.field).

tst.description: Standard macro: test register — sets Z,N via cmp-like behaviour without changing registers.

until.description: End of do/until loop: branch back if condition holds.

wait.description: Suspend clock until interrupt; PC updated only when ISR starts from hardware interrupt.

while.description: Start a while loop; condition ends with stays and a branch mnemonic; closed by wend.
while.example:
while
    tst r0
stays z
    dec r0
wend

xor.description: Bitwise XOR rn with rm into rm. Z,N reflect result; C,V cleared.
